crystal.unsupported: arbitrary propagation direction/azimuth; do not infer propagation from cut name

geometry.top_width_nm: rib top width, not bottom width
geometry.sidewall_angle_deg: measured from horizontal, strictly between 0 and 90

thickness_etch_relation.fixed_etch: thickness changes at fixed etch depth
thickness_etch_relation.fixed_slab: etch changes with thickness at fixed slab

wavelengths.pump_role: highest frequency even for SHG/SFG; not necessarily the experimental input named pump
wavelengths.center_nm: SHG fundamental; SPDC twice fixed 1D pump wavelength; SFG/DFG signal scan center
wavelengths.SHG: [axis/2, axis, axis]; default 1550±50 nm step20, plus center
wavelengths.spectral_2d: signal_nm/idler_nm increasing arrays; pump varies at every cell by energy conservation; SPDC uses nominal grating set at center degeneracy
wavelengths.unsupported: independent fixed-pump rectangular SPDC scan, absolute SPDC pair rate; do not claim varying-pump heatmap is a fixed-pump experiment

metrics.gvm: signed (ng_pump-ng_signal)/c in ps/m, plus absolute curve; signal-idler GVM requires new indicator extension
metrics.gvd: beta2=d²beta/domega²; objective wavelength is the scan axis, role selects actual wave; default three-point wavelength difference at ±2 nm; isolated anomalies limited to ceil(10%) per curve may upgrade to5/7; explicit5/7 supported; never9; convergence unverified unless requested
metrics.thickness_sensitivity: signed d(delta_beta)/dt using t±2 nm; optimization scores absolute value
metrics.efficiency: lossless per-wavelength matching classical coefficient; default L=5 mm; not actual percent; no SPDC absolute efficiency
metrics.tolerances: nominal plus true ± endpoints; required-period changes plotted, efficiency uses fixed nominal grating; ±5 nm tolerance independent of ±2 nm derivative
metrics.search: GP guides measured sampling; no tolerance means closest/minimum candidate only; best candidate curves, no default structure heatmap

extension_levels: task adapter / postprocess: stage, human approval, tests, execute
new solver physics: separately develop and validate

extensions.postprocess_output: metrics [{name,value,unit,definition,valid,source}], tables [{name,columns,units,rows}], curves [{name,x,y,x_unit,y_unit,definition,valid?}]; finite numbers or null only
extensions.scope: no solver calls or core-file modifications; approved Python is trusted local code, not an OS sandbox
extensions.review: code + tests + metadata content pinned; native Harness per-version approval; automatically test before enabling; old settings tokens supported

metadata.description: Signal-idler signed GVM and max absolute measured mismatch
metadata.applicability: Exported fixed/search curves with signal/idler beta1 ps/mm; demo remains synthetic

example.code:
import math

def analyze_result(context):
    rows=context.get("curves", [])
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError("requires fixed/search exported curves with role beta1")
    x=[];y=[];valid=[]
    for row in rows:
        a=row.get("signal_beta1_ps_mm");b=row.get("idler_beta1_ps_mm")
        ok=bool(row.get("valid")) and all(type(v) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(v) for v in (a,b))
        x.append(row["wavelength_nm"]);y.append((a-b)*1000 if ok else None);valid.append(ok)
    measured=[abs(v) for v in y if v is not None]
    return {"metrics":[{"name":"max_abs_signal_idler_gvm", "value":max(measured) if measured else None,
              "valid":bool(measured), "unit":"ps/m", "definition":"max measured abs(beta1_signal-beta1_idler)*1000; no interpolation over missing points",
              "source":"curves.signal_beta1_ps_mm and curves.idler_beta1_ps_mm"}],
            "curves":[{"name":"signal_idler_gvm","x":x,"y":y,"valid":valid,"x_unit":"nm","y_unit":"ps/m",
              "definition":"signed (beta1_signal-beta1_idler)*1000"}],
            "notes":["Additional analysis preserves source validation; missing points remain null."]}
example.tests:
from extension import analyze_result

def test_units_sign_and_missing():
    result=analyze_result({"curves":[
      {"wavelength_nm":1530,"signal_beta1_ps_mm":7,"idler_beta1_ps_mm":8,"valid":True},
      {"wavelength_nm":1550,"signal_beta1_ps_mm":None,"idler_beta1_ps_mm":8,"valid":False},
      {"wavelength_nm":1570,"signal_beta1_ps_mm":9,"idler_beta1_ps_mm":8,"valid":True}]})
    assert result["curves"][0]["y"]==[-1000,None,1000]
    assert result["metrics"][0]["value"]==1000

def test_no_successful_samples():
    result=analyze_result({"curves":[{"wavelength_nm":1550,"valid":False}]})
    assert result["metrics"][0]["valid"] is False
    assert result["metrics"][0]["value"] is None

def test_no_curve_data():
    try:
        analyze_result({"curves":[]})
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError("missing source data must fail")
